note: Life expectancy tables are not annual inflation figures. They change only when Treasury reissues them. No tax-year suffix.
primaryAuthority: Treas. Reg. 1.401(a)(9)-9(c) (Uniform Lifetime Table), as revised by T.D. 9930
secondaryConfirmation: Edward Jones 2026 Retirement Planning & Support card reproduces the identical table (advisor-supplied, 2026-08-19)
effectiveFor: distribution calendar years beginning on or after 2022-01-01
ageConvention: age attained at END of the distribution calendar year

applicableAge.note1959: SECURE 2.0 sec. 107 drafting glitch; Treasury resolved the 1959 cohort to age 73 in T.D. 10001.

stillRequired.jointLifeAndLastSurvivor: REQUIRED when the sole beneficiary is a spouse more than 10 years younger. Treas. Reg. 1.401(a)(9)-9(d). NOT YET LOADED - blocks that scenario.
stillRequired.singleLifeExpectancy: REQUIRED for inherited accounts and eligible designated beneficiaries. Treas. Reg. 1.401(a)(9)-9(b). NOT YET LOADED - blocks Phase 9.
